hero.headline: Kitchen and bathroom renovations in Augusta, planned and finished properly.
hero.subhead: Kitchen and bathroom renovations for homeowners across Augusta, Martinez, Evans and Grovetown. Tell us about the room and get a clear written estimate.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the Space Create Renovations assistant. Planning a new kitchen or bathroom? Tell me a bit about the room and I'll help you get an estimate or book a time.

about.headline: You picture the room. We plan it and build it properly.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a renovation: a clear price before work starts, a layout that suits how the family uses the room, and finishes that still look right years later. Every job is planned around that, from the first measure to the final walkthrough.

cards.title: Kitchens that don't work anymore
cards.body: Not enough counter space, dated cabinets or a layout that fights you every night. We rework it around how you cook.

cards.title: Tired bathrooms
cards.body: Worn tile, an old tub or a vanity that's seen better days, renovated into a room you're glad to walk into.

cards.title: Homes that need to work better
cards.body: Repairs, flooring and changes like wider doorways, so the house works for everyone living in it.

about.closing: Not sure where to start? Tell us about the room and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Getting a kitchen or bathroom renovated in Augusta shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: You leave a message, wait a week, and still don't have a number to plan around.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A one-line quote that keeps growing once the old cabinets or tile come out.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Start dates slip and the kitchen or bathroom stays out of action longer than anyone said.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Dust through the house and debris left in the driveway while the work drags on.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear estimate.

solutions.headline: Straightforward renovations built around clear communication.

services.title: Kitchen renovations
services.body: Kitchen renovations planned around how you use the room: layout, cabinets, counters and finishes, with the scope in writing first.

services.title: Bathroom renovations
services.body: Bathroom renovations from the shower and vanity to the floor, with a layout and finishes chosen for how the room gets used.

services.title: Repairs & smaller projects
services.body: Flooring and leak repairs, plus home modifications like widened doorways for wheelchair access. Smaller jobs get the same care as a full remodel.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Estimate it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your estimate
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a call. A ZIP code and a rough idea of the room is plenty.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We measure up, talk through layout and finishes, and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.body: A start date you can plan around, with the work area protected and cleaned up each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished room with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it properly.

themes.title: Kitchen & bath focused
themes.body: Kitchens and bathrooms are the work, not a side line.

themes.title: Written estimates
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you can compare it side by side.

themes.title: Detail in the finish
themes.body: Straight tile lines, clean edges and trim finished properly.

themes.title: Direct communication
themes.body: One point of contact who answers your questions as the job goes.

realReviews.author: Tabitha Corley
realReviews.text: The before and after don’t even look like the same house. From demo to completion, Roman was incredibly communicative and helpful. He helped manage my expectations while also offering different ideas and delivered above and beyond what I thought we could do with the original space. We haven’t cooked in our kitchen in over a year and now we can’t stop.

realReviews.author: Vivian Ghalam
realReviews.text: Space Create Renovations did an amazing Job. Roman explained the entire process from start to finish, and it went as promised. We cannot be more happy with it. The price and the quality of work was fair and outstanding. Everything that we discussed the way it would go went better than it was promised. Definitely recommend Space Create Renovations and Roman for the future projects. We cannot wait to start the next project this winter.

realReviews.author: Anita P
realReviews.text: We had an outstanding experience with Space Create Renovations! My dad needed modifications to make his home wheelchair accessible, and they went above and beyond. They expanded his bedroom and widened every doorway with incredible attention to detail. What truly stood out was their patience, professionalism, and kindness—especially working with my elderly father. Every question was answered, every concern addressed, and we always felt heard. The quality of the work and the level of care they provided gave our entire family peace of mind. We have already booked them for more!  I highly recommend them!

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your kitchen or bathroom?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.a: Send the project through the form or give us a call. We'll ask a few questions, come out to measure if the job needs it, and send a written estimate that lists the scope and price.

faq.q: Which areas around Augusta do you cover?
faq.a: Augusta and the surrounding area, including Martinez, Evans, Grovetown and Hephzibah. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: How long does a kitchen or bathroom renovation take?
faq.a: It depends on the size of the room and the finishes you choose. You'll get a timeline with your written estimate, so you know how long the room will be out of action before anything starts.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the project and book a site visit if it needs one.
